author: bardic-inspiration
name: Graveclaw Bear
summary: A bear raised from a snowed-in den, its flesh slipping from the bone.
description: Hunters find graveclaw bears at the mouths of caves where something fed them to the ground. They are slow to tire and stranger to kill, and a pelt taken from one stays cold.

traits.name: Undead Fortitude
traits.text: If damage reduces the bear to 0 Hit Points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a {dc=5} plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a success, the bear drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

traits.name: Carrion Regeneration
traits.text: The bear regains 5 Hit Points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 Hit Point and hasn't taken Radiant or Fire damage since then.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The bear makes one Rending Bite attack and one Claw attack.

actions.name: Rending Bite
actions.onHit: and the target has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc:str}) if the bear isn't already grappling a creature.
